author: CyberStorm
text_post: Myself, my work colleague and her! About 10 days ago I send this girl who works in my office complex (but for a different company) a Facebook message.  We chat and I get her BBM PIN and number. We've been chatting and flirting for the best part of 10 days. Things seemed to be going great. I hadn't set up a Day 2 yet though or called her. Then, last Friday a work colleague (who is a friend) asks her for her number and BB PIN. He calls her and chats and setup a lunch date for himself, myself and her for tomorrow. Today at work he tells me that he is just being friendly and that he is going to back off becuase I was in pursuit before he was. I'm not really sure how to work this now. With girls, I'm usually funny, witty, charming, DHV'ing, get her qualifying...all easy things to do when you're alone with a girl, but add in my work colleague (friend) and the dynamic shifts. I want to be the AMOG, but my work colleague is also funny (albeit very childish) and he is into racing and has two really fast cars. Does anyone has any advice regarding this situation and how I should approach it?

author: bluefin
text_post: 10 days of chatting?  Do you want a chat buddy or a girl to fuck?  Work colleague saw an opening and moved in.  If he's serious about backing you up he'll either bail last minute and the two of you can go or he'll talk you up throughout as a good wing man.  Or you could back off and let him go after her, but I don't believe in getting in a pissing contest over a girl with my friends.  It's harder to get a good friend, girls come and go.
